name: The ranged slot counts toward the average item level (#7776)
contract: Live CoA sends the character sheet's average item level (SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT_ADDON field 5, read by UnitAverageItemLevel) over seventeen slots: every equipment slot except the shirt and the tabard, so the ranged slot (wand, bow, idol, totem, relic) and the off hand count. Live probes on 2026-09-02 returned 200/17 at level 34 and 701/16 at level 60; the off hand slot is left out while a two-handed weapon is wielded without an off hand item, which gives sixteen slots. A Fire Wand (item level 12) beside a one-handed Dreadblade therefore raises the average by 12/17 = 0.706, and swapping it for a Scorching Wand (item level 35) beside the two-handed Magus Long Staff raises it by 23/16 = 1.4375.

steps.label: Equip the Fire Wand (item level 12) in the ranged slot
The Fire Wand raises the average by 12/17 beside a one-handed weapon
Wield the two-handed Magus Long Staff (item level 58)
Replace the Fire Wand with the Scorching Wand (item level 35)
The 23 item levels gained in the ranged slot are averaged over sixteen slots beside a two-hander
